name: Wrench
tagline: A garage log that tracks each vehicle's service and flags what is due next
description: Describe each vehicle in the driveway once, by VIN or by year, make and model, and it keeps a running service history, warns you before the next oil change or tyre rotation falls overdue, and helps you weigh a do-it-yourself fix with the right parts against booking a shop, towing questions included.
author: treyvis
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
